environment.session: one uninterrupted sequential session; all prior partial samples discarded

method.endpoint: call -> 64 Promise checkpoints -> sentinel setImmediate; validation OFF uses one pass, ON drains 64 further checkpoints and uses a second same-queue FIFO sentinel for deferred error-event resets
method.gc: explicit collection outside timed span; check-phase anchor completes GC follow-up before sample
method.correction: empty constants pooled separately for the one-pass OFF and two-pass ON paths; each path uses the same fixed end-to-end and microtask constants for both versions
method.callbackFallback: uninstrumented microtask time + callback execution measured later at one scheduling boundary; all three runs use sum if any run fails validation B
method.callbackPairing: separate diagnostic samples combined by ordinal within the same fixture/run; median of sample sums, plus sum of medians recorded
method.noise: predeclared max(1us, empty-wait p95 absolute deviation per call + independent median bootstrap 99% half-widths + calibration median uncertainty); conservative noise comparison, not a significance/equivalence test
method.bootstrap: 1000 deterministic seeded resamples; intervals and tolerance per row/run
method.tie: 94C-02: any run <= target and any run > target => tie/met; otherwise pooled median ratio; core target 1.5

branched.criterion: round 91: growth in untouched branch count and duplicated phase work; ratios alone confer no pass

discardedPartialRuns.source: this turn before nested validation callback correction

earlySentinel.expectedFailure: mount FIFO: pending engine callbacks omitted

preFixGuard.expectedFailure: old expected HEAD rejected current HEAD before measurement

preliminaryNote: Nested validation callback regression check only; no preliminary timing entered the official table.
